about: Titles are written in the messy style real Amazon and eBay listings use —
inconsistent spacing, mixed units, marketing noise, model numbers dropped
mid-string — so normalisation is genuinely tested rather than fed clean input.
PROVENANCE: these are constructed, not harvested. Fetching real listing
titles would mean pulling retailer HTML, which CLAUDE.md §1.2 forbids
outright, and the official APIs need credentials this repository does not
have. They are modelled on real listing conventions and real product names.
capacityTb is decimal terabytes (null when the title yields no defensible
capacity). publishable mirrors isPublishable(): false means the listing is
quarantined, which is a correct outcome, not a gap to close.
